_about: What's new, shown once on the first open of a new version (WhatsNew in pwa-whatsnew.js). Each version keeps two to four items: a title, one sentence and where Show me goes. Newest version first. The same text can go in the stores' What's new.

items.title: Scan a whole shelf
items.text: Point the camera at a shop shelf and every bottle it can read comes back matched to your taste, best first. Two free shelf scans a month.

items.title: Your rating comes first
items.text: A bottle you've already rated now shows your rating, on a wine list, a shelf or its own page, with what we'd have predicted beside it.

items.title: Told when there's an update
items.text: When a newer Vinterest is in the store, Home says so, with a button straight to it.
